disagreements.text: The lender may revise the rate of interest at its sole discretion without notice to the borrower.
The borrower grants the lender access to the contacts, photographs and location stored on the borrower's mobile device.
This agreement shall renew automatically for successive twelve-month periods unless cancelled thirty days in advance.
The borrower authorises the employer to deduct the instalment directly from the borrower's monthly salary.
All disputes shall be referred to arbitration at a seat chosen by the lender and the borrower waives the right to approach any court.
Liquidated damages equal to three months' instalments shall be payable if the borrower terminates this agreement early.
The borrower shall have no right to dispute any charge debited to the account after a period of seven days.
No prepayment penalty shall be charged if the borrower repays the loan in full before the end of the tenure.
The rate of interest is fixed at 9.5% per annum for the entire tenure and shall not be revised.
The lender shall provide a statement of account to the borrower on the first day of every month without charge.
A grace period of fifteen days is allowed after the due date before any late payment charge is levied.
All fees and charges applicable to this facility are listed in the schedule annexed to this agreement.
Any dispute arising under this agreement shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the courts at the borrower's place of residence.
The security deposit shall be refunded in full within thirty days of handing over vacant possession of the premises.
The borrower shall be entitled to a copy of this agreement duly signed by both parties at the time of execution.
This loan carries no processing fee and no documentation charges of any kind.
The cardholder shall not be liable for any transaction reported as unauthorised within three days of the statement date.
The borrower may nominate a person to receive the documents in the event of the borrower's demise.
